newsitem.title: INDIA: India lowers capital gains for partnership firms.
newsitem.headline: India lowers capital gains for partnership firms.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Friday that capital gains of partnership firms will be reduced to 20 percent from 30 percent.
Currently, individuals, firms and foreign companies pay capital gains of 20 percent while partnership firms pay 30 percent.
"In order to remove the discrimination, I am reducing the capital gains of partnership firms from the existing 30 percent to 20 percent," Chidambaram told the lower house of the parliament.
